nodes.name: Receive Operator Allocation Request
nodes.notes: Entry point for the integrated orchestration. This workflow delegates deterministic behavior to existing sub-workflows and Python APIs.

nodes.name: Execute Intent Review Sub-workflow
nodes.notes: Calls intent_to_patch_review.workflow.json. Expected normalized output: status, ids, payload, errors.

nodes.name: Execute Release Approval Sub-workflow
nodes.notes: Calls patch_release_approval.workflow.json. Release approval remains responsible for human decision handling.

nodes.name: Execute Supervisor Reconciliation Sub-workflow
nodes.notes: Calls released_trt_to_reconciliation.workflow.json. Supervisor Python remains the source of reconciliation decisions.

nodes.name: Execute ScenarioSpec Generation Sub-workflow
nodes.notes: Calls generate_scenario_spec.workflow.json. This does not call Isaac Sim.
